answer: The tundra counter is kept in cipher and marble publishes each reset. Anyone as a result has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 29 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 29 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Each duplicate costs another 60 dollars in locked collateral and another 5 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
